description: This file defines an Express middleware function 'extractOrganization' that extracts an organization identifier from HTTP request headers, query parameters, or body, and attaches it to the request object for downstream use. It also provides helper functions for filtering and stamping documents with the organization ID.

methods.name: extractOrganization
methods.description: Returns an Express middleware function that extracts organization ID from request headers, query, or body, and attaches helper functions and properties to the request object.
